props.name: interval
props.comment: Milliseconds between checks. Defaults to one hour.

props.name: fetchOptions
props.comment: Read at each check. `cache: "no-store"` always overrides it.

props.name: disabled
props.comment: Never fetch. Defaults to `true` outside production.

props.name: onNewVersionAvailable
props.comment: Called once, when a new build is found.
